text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambique's parliament on Wednesday voted to postpone discussion of a report on its 1996 budget spending until the next parliamentary sitting, following demands that an independent audit of its books also be made available to deputies.

- Mozambique's first census since 1980, when the population was 12.13 million, begins on Friday and will continue for two weeks. Unofficial estimates put the present figure at 17.40 million, expected to rise to 20 million by the year 2000.
